title: Hardware/Desktop Support
description:
We are looking for a **System Analyst** to support and maintain the hospital’s end-user IT infrastructure, including desktops, operating systems, standard applications, printers, scanners, and other peripheral devices. The role involves installing, configuring, and troubleshooting hardware and software, performing preventive maintenance, handling OS updates and system recovery, maintaining IT asset inventory, and ensuring the smooth day-to-day functioning of user systems across hospital departments. The candidate will provide first- and second-level technical support, coordinate with vendors for hardware repairs and warranty services, assist with IT deployments and upgrades, and work closely with Network, Server, and Application teams to resolve technical issues.

The candidate is expected to follow hospital IT policies, standard operating procedures, and ISO 27001 information security guidelines, while maintaining proper documentation of incidents, asset movements, maintenance activities, and system configurations. Good troubleshooting, communication, coordination, and documentation skills are essential. **An understanding of how software applications work, including application workflows, databases, or system integrations, will be an added advantage.** Candidates who can identify opportunities for application improvements, suggest process automation, or contribute ideas for application development and optimization will be preferred.

Pay: From ₹20,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Technical Support - Networking,Desktop,Laptop & Printer (Fresher)
description:
Defra Systems is looking for enthusiastic and technically interested freshers to join our team as a Technical Support \& Field Service Technician.

This role involves providing technical support for Networking, Desktop, Laptop and Printer systems, including customer\-site visits and field service work.

Key Responsibilities

\* Desktop and laptop installation, troubleshooting and maintenance

\* Printer installation, configuration and basic troubleshooting

\* Basic networking setup and troubleshooting

\* Router, switch and LAN connectivity support

\* Windows installation, software installation and system configuration

\* Hardware diagnosis and basic repair support

\* Customer\-site visits for installation and technical support

\* Attend service calls and resolve basic technical issues

\* Properly document service work and report completed tasks

\* Coordinate with customers and the technical team

\* Learn and follow company procedures and technical standards

Requirements

\* Freshers are welcome to apply

\* Basic knowledge of computers and hardware

\* Basic understanding of networking is preferred

\* Interest in technical support and field\-service work

\* Willingness to travel to customer locations

\* Good communication and problem\-solving skills

\* Ability to work independently and as part of a team

\* Two\-wheeler and valid driving licence will be an advantage

Job Details

Salary: ₹6,000/month

Working Hours: 9:30 AM – 7:00 PM

Job Type: Full\-time

Experience: Fresher / 0–1 year

Work Type: Field / Offsite Customer Support

Travel: The role involves travelling to customer locations for service and technical support.
